verdict.rationale: Orb documents accrued revenue tracking before invoices, real-time webhooks, and customer credit balance alerts, plus usage-threshold triggers for product-led growth—covering the core of real-time usage/cost visibility and alerting. However, evidence doesn't show an explicit customer-facing/team dashboard for 'current-cycle usage' in real time, nor concrete invoice-surprise-prevention UI beyond alert creation API and revenue tracking docs. missing for 10: dedicated real-time usage dashboard UI evidence, independent/hands-on confirmation that alerts reliably prevent invoice surprises, clarity on team-visible usage views vs. just API/webhooks.
